$comment: Phase 0 bundle baseline (CHOICE_OF_LIFE_AAA_UPGRADE_PLAN.md §14 Phase 0, §0 L5/L9). These are the measured production numbers at the time the deploy was first gated on verification. `npm run budget` fails against the §13 release targets; this file records where the build actually stands so the ratchet can block regressions while Phase 1 brings the numbers down. Lower these values as the work lands. Never raise one without recording why.
recordedFrom: npm run build on main, Node 26

revisions.why: Deliberate. The ratchet correctly blocked this. The growth is the stage-player identity seed (playerIdentitySeed) plus the caregiver support thresholds and their catalog-derived reachability helper. Both fix defects that made player choices meaningless: the avatar re-rolled skin tone, face and accessory every chapter, and two of three education support tiers were unreachable. 399 bytes uncompressed is an acceptable price, and the compressed critical path stays well inside the 350 KiB §13 target at 212 KB gzip.
revisions.note: Runtime transfer improved substantially in the same change: removing the import-time Western atlas warm cuts about 3 MB of PNG off every page load. That does not show here because the sheets are still emitted into dist by `new URL(...)` references; only Phase 1 per-stage atlases will move totalBytes.

revisions.why: Deliberate; the ratchet blocked it. The growth is the childhood scene render key, the encounter tray focus restoration, and two [hidden] catch-all CSS rules. All three fix defects that were visible to the player: characters rebuilt and stuttered several times a second, keyboard focus fell to <body> after every encounter choice, and the childhood play controls plus a duplicate later-life 'Return to title' stayed on screen while the code believed they were hidden.
revisions.note: Compressed critical path remains inside the 350 KiB §13 target at 212 KB gzip.

revisions.why: Deliberate; the ratchet blocked it. All CSS, no JavaScript. Fixes the newborn stage UI: the control pad rendered as a near-opaque dark ellipse covering 37.5% of the playfield and 100% of the player on mobile (a specificity collision between an overlay design and a button-row design); the choice tray covered 79.2% of the playfield and 100% of both the player and the caregiver, violating plan §8.1; and HUD text ran as small as 8.8px with the three core score values at 10.88px.
revisions.note: Measured after: pad and tray no longer overlap the playfield at any width, no HUD collisions on mobile or desktop, no text under 12px, no touch target under 44px, no horizontal scroll.

revisions.why: Deliberate; the ratchet blocked it. All CSS. Raised 48 font-size declarations below 12px to a 0.75rem floor across every stage stylesheet, made the runner control pad a true circle (inline-size 9.4rem fought its 169px grid, producing an ellipse at border-radius 50%), lightened the runner pad from 84/90% to 38/48% opacity, repaired its sub-480px grid (a 2-column override against 3-column grid-template-areas), and gave the adult season toggle a 44px touch target.
revisions.note: Audited every stage view by mounting it in the live browser at 1280x800 and 375x812: newborn, runner, childhood, education, career, adult, later-life, encounters and gallery all report no text under 12px, no touch target under 44px, no viewport overflow and no horizontal scroll.

revisions.why: Deliberate; the ratchet blocked it. Two correctness guards found by playing the game to its ending headlessly. All five stage reducers were exhaustive switches with no default, so any action outside the union returned undefined; the sessions assigned that back to their own state and every later call threw 'Cannot read properties of undefined', permanently bricking the chapter so the life could not be finished. They now throw, which the shell already converts into a clean player notice. chooseAdultRoute also validated its phase but not its route id, so an unknown id reached definition.label and surfaced a raw TypeError to the player as a notice.
revisions.note: A full-life playthrough now runs as a test: new life through newborn, encounters, childhood, education, career, adult and later life to a biography.

accepted.totalBytes: 5.1x over the 20 MiB target. Cause: the build emits every character/career/occupation/summer/pet atlas for all four art sets and both genders. Phase 1 per-stage preload groups and compact runtime atlases are the fix.
accepted.mainEntryJsBytes: 14% over the 500 KB target uncompressed, but the compressed critical path (gzip 212 KB, brotli 173 KB) is already inside the 350 KiB §13 target, so this is a lower priority than the atlas weight.
accepted.pngFiles: The Phase 1 budget profile bans PNG output outright while the game ships PNG atlases. Phase 1 must replace the ban with a per-file and total cap (§0 L5).
